These planks automatically stack themselves into a precise, orderly, and structured pile. The motion is continuous, with the neat, geometric pile growing as more logs are milled into planks.

statement: This sketch depicts a continuous sawmill process where cylindrical brown logs are sliced into rectangular tan planks that fall and stack into an orderly pile. Using p5.js WEBGL renderer, I simulate the physics of falling and stacking with gravity, collision detection, and spatial partitioning. The scene is fully self-contained with no external dependencies beyond the core p5 library, demonstrating a clean, geometric animation of industrial processing.
